document.title: Summary of Benefits and Coverage, coverage period beginning on or after 01/01/2026, Individual AvMed Entrust Gold 125 (2026), Plan Type HMO
document.url_source: URLForSummaryofBenefitsCoverage in the plan year 2026 Plan Attributes PUF, row 19898FL0340001-01; the carrier's Entrust page, https://www.avmed.org/en/individuals-families/entrust, links "Entrust Gold 125" to the same address
document.retrieval_note: The maintainer downloaded it in a browser on 2026-10-27. The host answered HTTP 401 for its robots.txt (https://apps.avmed.com/robots.txt, read 2026-10-27), so automated fetching is not known to be allowed, and this check did not do it.
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw, both with -enc UTF-8. The SBC is printed pages 1 to 7 of 7, which are PDF pages 1 to 7. The -layout output interleaves the columns of the service chart, so its rows were read from the -raw output. The chart's columns are "In-Network (You will pay the least)" and "Out-of-Network (You will pay the most)"; the in-network column prints "Independent facility" and "Hospital-affiliated facility" amounts, which are the file's in-network tier 1 and tier 2 (MultipleInNetworkTiers "Yes"), the document's IN and IN2. Page 2 says "All copayment and coinsurance costs shown in this chart are after your deductible has been met, if a deductible applies.", and page 1 names the services covered before the deductible; a value printed "after deductible" is checked as applies_to_deductible true, a copay printed without it as false. The prescription drug rows (pages 2 and 3) are not checked, as in the UHC Bronze Essential check: the medical MVP's services are medical.

checks.printed: Yes. See www.avmed.org or call 1-800-477-8768 for a list of network providers.
checks.note: A contradiction on a link, not a cost share. The Network PUF gives the plan's network, FLN001, NetworkURL "https://avmed.healthsparq.com/healthsparq/public/#/one/insurerCode=AVMED_I&brandCode=AVMED", which the document holds; the SBC prints the carrier's home page. Addresses are compared with the scheme, a leading "www." and the case of the host ignored, so the printed address is written here in the document's form, and the 2 still differ in host and path. On 2026-10-27 https://www.avmed.org answered HTTP 200 after 1 redirect, the carrier's home page; the filed address's host answers automated requests with a page that turns them away, so it was not resolved.
